name: big_bench_audio
description: A collection of audio-based tasks derived from the BIG-bench effort, designed to test language models' and multimodal systems' ability to process, interpret, and reason about audio inputs. It includes tasks such as audio classification, audio-based question answering, and other speech/audio understanding problems to probe non-text capabilities. The suite is intended to extend BIG-bench style evaluation into the audio/speech modality and stress generalization on auditory inputs.
reputation: An extension of the BIG-bench family with modest adoption so far; used by researchers exploring audio and multimodal evaluation beyond text-only benchmarks.
